arguments.text: 6000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000 m; last leg 1000 m). Leg 1 heads N into ~0.24 m/s push against. Pre-race CP: pod 163 W / 15.8 kJ, boat 90 W. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) catch incidents: weed/drag (GPS speed falls at same pod power and HR), pod drift (pod power moves but HR, rate and GPS speed do not), instrument faults (HR strap, GPS), course or distance changes by radio; (2) keep the boat computer right (pod_gain, race distance); (3) tell the paddler only what helps. Check legs() and measure() per leg pair: share of pod power reaching boat should be stable leg to leg. Near 800 m to go, make sure reserve is spent (pacer finish rule needs pod reserve >40%).

arguments.text: 4 min (673 m): pacer eased at 111 s. Pod 171 W (CP 163), pod reserve 54% vs boat reserve 22%. Boat-model power / pod power rose 0.52 (min 1-3) to 0.62 (min 3-4). Possible: push estimate off (no turn yet, push_local -0.09..-0.15 vs push_along -0.2) or pod reading low. HR 138,167,176,178,179 climbing slowly. Re-check with measure() across leg 1 vs leg 2 after the first turn.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: From 270 s pod power ramped 170 to 210+ W (30-s mean, still rising ~0.4 W/s) while stroke rate (64.5), heart rate (179-180, trend -1.8 bpm/min) and GPS speed (2.81 to 2.76) did not rise; boat-model power fell 105 to 100 W. A real +23% effort would raise speed ~7% and heart rate. Share boat/pod 0.61 before; true effort ~164 W now.

arguments.text: 7 min (1176 m): POD DRIFTING HIGH from ~270 s. Pod 172 W -> 210 W (still rising) with rate, HR, GPS speed flat/falling; boat-model power 105->100 W. Set pod_gain 1.30 ramped 270-420 s. Pre-drift reference: pod 172 W = boat 105 W (share 0.61), HR 179, GPS 2.79 on leg 1 (against current). Drift may continue: re-check corrected pod power vs boat power and HR after the turn; raise pod_gain if corrected pod keeps rising.

arguments.reason: re-check pod drift after correction (corrected pod vs boat power, HR)

text: Corrected the pod gain (pod reading drifted ~30% high from 270 s while HR, rate and speed stayed flat) so the pacer stops seeing a false drain; no cue: nothing the paddler needs to change.
